sourceProjection.basis: The museum architect's page 3 ground-floor drawing was visually checked as an overhead plan. The strict semantic raster retains original source pixels for connected structural walls and actual support rows; door leaves and swing arcs, stair treads, ramp edges, route traces and cloister-bay diagonals remain flat detail. Tower, scale and site graphics are excluded.

review: Architect project sheet page 3, visually reviewed at four-times render scale. The strict derivation isolates the museum wings and cloister at equal x/y scale and retains only original blue source pixels. Connected dark structural cores and actual support-row profiles are walls; fine wall edges, door leaves and swing arcs, all visible stair treads, ramp edges, circulation traces and cloister-bay diagonals remain flat detail. The Tower inset, scale, roads, trees and planted-court graphics are outside the extraction scope. The sheet does not name current collection zones and supplies no complete upper-floor plan, so route themes are not assigned to rooms.
internalNotes: 仅绘制已发表的底层建筑平面；上层礼仪藏品空间仍缺少正投影平面。
细墙线、门扇与开启弧、可见踏步、坡道边缘、流线和回廊跨间对角线均保留为平面细节，不再被开运算删除或挤出为墙。
回廊停点只绑定至有据可查的庭院范围；图中没有现行藏品分区标签，因此主教座堂／洗礼堂雕塑、乔瓦尼·皮萨诺及斜塔构件主题保持未绑定。
本项目图记录建筑方案而非当前游客通行或展品位置。
limitations: 目前仅包含建筑师方案所示底层建筑与回廊；未取得上层完整正投影、分隔、楼梯或电梯落点平面。
现行雕塑、斜塔构件等藏品位置与当前参观流线没有可靠展厅级证据，保持未定位。

rasterLayers.reason: Black pixels are original architect-plan pixels from connected dark structural cores and actual support rows. Disconnected route marks and fine symbols are not promoted by line width alone.
Gray pixels are original door arcs, stair treads, ramp edges, circulation traces, cloister diagonals and nearby fine architectural linework kept flat.
